scientific.integrity: The proof uses exact Fourier and deficit identities from the cited sources, a direct localization argument forcing high-frequency excess energy to fourth order, and a quadratic completion on the second harmonic. Numerical evaluations were used only as sanity checks, not as proof.
scientific.limitations: The theorem identifies the shrinking-neighborhood quartic constants at the constant extremizer. It does not determine the global sharp constants for cycles with at least five vertices or for the circle, and it makes no claim about the exceptional four-cycle.

title: Exact local quartic stability constants at the constant extremizer on cycles
